result.summary: Found 1 issue: an untranslated localization key is displayed as the section heading. The rest of the page renders correctly; the partially visible 'Trattoria Piccol...' card at the right edge and the cut-off pizza card at the bottom are expected scrollable/scrollable-list behavior.

issues.description: Section title shows the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of the translated heading, indicating a missing translation resource.
issues.suggestion: Replace the raw key with the localized string, e.g. 'Popular near you', and verify the translation resource is bundled for all locales.
